config.name: seed_plus_query_semantic
config.derived_query: Value-based care enablement platforms for independent primary care practices and accountable care organizations

candidates.name: Availity
candidates.description: Availity fits because it serves healthcare providers and explicitly says its platform enables collaboration in a "value-based care environment".
candidates.rationale: Adjacent healthcare IT platform, but focused on payer-provider transactions rather than value-based care enablement for independent practices.

candidates.name: Innovaccer
candidates.description: Innovaccer matches because it targets healthcare operations with specialties including "value-based care" and supports providers with a healthcare intelligence platform.
candidates.rationale: Both are healthcare value-based care enablement platforms selling to providers and ACOs with overlapping buyer personas.

candidates.name: Qlik Healthcare
candidates.description: Qlik Healthcare is aimed at "value-based care" analytics and helps healthcare organizations use data to improve outcomes and cost performance, which aligns with enablement platforms in this space.
candidates.rationale: Healthcare analytics vendor, not a value-based care enablement platform for primary care practices and ACOs.

candidates.name: Chris Walker
candidates.description: Chris Walker lists "Value-based Care Enablement" among areas of interest, but this is an individual profile rather than a company platform, so it only loosely fits.
candidates.rationale: Individual profile, not a company; not a comparable value-based care platform or buyer organization.

candidates.name: IDS Healthcare
candidates.description: IDS Healthcare specializes in AI-assisted RCM and explicitly says it focuses on "value-based care," helping provider organizations with administrative and revenue-cycle support.
candidates.rationale: Adjacent healthcare vendor, but primarily AI-assisted RCM/administrative support rather than an independent primary care value-based care platform.

candidates.name: EXL Health
candidates.description: EXL Health helps provider organizations manage risk, improve outcomes, and optimize network performance, which is consistent with value-based care enablement for provider groups.
candidates.rationale: EXL Health is a services/analytics provider to healthcare organizations, not a value-based care enablement platform like Aledade.

candidates.name: symplr
candidates.description: symplr provides healthcare operations software used by provider organizations and health plans, with capabilities in quality and provider data management that can support value-based care workflows.
candidates.rationale: Healthcare software, but broader provider operations platform; not a direct value-based care enablement peer to Aledade.

candidates.name: +Oscar
candidates.description: +Oscar is a healthcare activation platform for providers and payors that helps build patient relationships and drive outcomes, which plausibly supports value-based care enablement.
candidates.rationale: Healthcare platform for providers and payors; overlaps with value-based care enablement and similar buyer personas.

candidates.name: Fellows at Panoramic Health
candidates.description: Panoramic Health is a physician-led platform centered on provider autonomy and explicitly includes "Value-Based Care" and "Practice Solutions," matching independent practice enablement.
candidates.rationale: Panoramic Health is a physician platform/provider group, not a comparable value-based care enablement vendor for independent primary care practices.

candidates.name: Care Coordination and Population Health
candidates.description: Centro Healthcare supports providers and "Accountable Care Organizations (ACOs)" with care coordination, population health, and physician practice efficiency services.
candidates.rationale: A service provider to ACOs, not a comparable value-based care platform for independent primary care practices.
